name: inventory-software-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Smart Inventory Management System

scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && (ls venv/bin/python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./venv/bin/python3 main.py || python3 main.py)
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
